stem:
Study the photograph and answer the question that follows.

Master Sergeant Roy Benavidez saved the lives of fellow soldiers while under heavy enemy attack and after sustaining wounds while assisting on a team extraction in Vietnam on May 2, 1968.

In recognition of the actions described above, Master Sergeant Roy Benavidez was —

options.label: A
options.text: given an early honorable discharge from U.S. military service

options.label: B
options.text: awarded the Congressional Medal of Honor

options.label: C
options.text: made an honorary member of the United Nations

options.label: D
options.text: awarded the Legion of Honor ribbon

visual_elements: photograph of Master Sergeant Roy Benavidez in military uniform with medals
